race.comment: ONYSPEED (10) built momentum in the straight and wasn't beaten far last start over 1300m at Dubbo. Coming back in trip is the query but she does drop 4kgs and is very fit, so she can run another big race without surprising. CAMPARI TWIST (4) raced handy then held on fairly to finish fourth when resuming in a BM82 over this course and distance last time out. Drops in grade significantly today and the second-up record is better. More than capable of taking this out. VIERVILLE (1) took on open company over this distance at Dubbo recently when resuming from a spell and didn't do a bad job to be beaten by just 2.3 lengths. Will find this far easier so must be considered despite the big weight. LYON (2) returns from a three-month spell after taking all before him last prep. May find this a touch too short but should be powering home. NEVERMISTA (5) disappointed in a Rosehill Highway ten days ago but can bounce back in this more suitable race.
